reasoning: Ficino's Latin Pimander (the Corpus Hermeticum I-XIV) has been fully translated into English multiple times. Everard (1650) translated it from Ficino's Latin (pre-1900). Copenhaver (1992, Cambridge UP) translated the underlying Greek comprehensively. Latham (2020, Falcon Books) is a modern English translation directly from Ficino's Latin — same source text as ours. Under the source-language rule, any of these three triggers not_first.
